analogy.rationale: TNF production inhibitors act on the TNF cytokine/receptor axis, which signals through NF-kB and stress MAPK cascades; these cells express TNF receptors but the transcriptional footprint of blocking TNF production is modest and overlaps most with NF-kB/IKK and p38/JNK pathway inhibitors.
